title: 第25章 编号2333第26章 东曦峰
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
秦怀安等人随筑基期修士走下飞舟之后，飞舟就飞走了。招收的内门弟子并没有同他们一起下来。
看来内门弟子和他们入宗报到的地点也是不一样的。
那位筑基期修士带领他们来到广场边上的一栋建筑门口，抱拳朝门口的几位修士道：“各位师兄好，在下容成峰陆勋，这些弟子是云田坊市招收的外门弟子。”
门口几位修士也站起来，为首的一位儒雅青年含笑说道：“原来是陆师弟，久仰久仰！辛苦陆师弟了，我们来交接一下吧。”
之后，带秦怀安他们过来的筑基期修士把登记了这批外门弟子信息的名册交给那位儒雅青年，“请师兄查验。”
“好，请稍等。”
说罢，儒雅青年朝秦怀安等人说道：“各位师弟师妹好，我是东曦峰的何志平，负责办理你们的入宗事宜，大家可以称呼我何师兄。”
“所有新招收的外门弟子前十年都统一归东曦峰管理，这十年内，你们都属于东曦峰的弟子。”
“大家都拿出招收时发给你们的令牌，听到名字后来领取正式的弟子身份牌。”
“张师弟，你来点名；陈师弟、王师弟，你们负责更换令牌。”何志平朝他旁边的两位修士吩咐道。
“是，何师兄！”三人应道。
“张传旺！”
“到！”一个憨厚的青年应声走出人群，急忙跑上前去，拿出自己的令牌，“各位师兄，这是小弟的令牌。”
接过这位憨厚青年的令牌，检查过后，陈姓修士拿出一块赤铜色令牌，以指代笔，在令牌上凌空虚点，然后对憨厚青年说道：“往身份牌输入你的一道灵力。”
“是。”憨厚青年手指点向令牌，输入了一道灵力。
“好，张师弟拿好你的身份牌，先到旁边等候。”
“刘姝汶！”
“到！”一位十七八岁的俏丽女修跑上前去。
......
“秦怀安！”听到自己的名字，秦怀安跑上前去，换了身份牌之后，他也站到了一边。他这也算是正式成为黄山剑宗的弟子了，虽然是外门。

身份牌是赤铜色的，主要材料应该是赤铜精，手掌大的牌子，入手很有分量，足有十多斤重。
上面写着‘东曦峰
秦怀安
二三三三’。
东曦峰应该就是他们所属的山峰，二三三三应该是一个编号，不知代表了什么。
大约一个半时辰之后，他们云田坊市这批外门弟子都拿到了自己的身份牌。
“陆师弟，已查验完毕，没什么问题，多谢陆师弟了。”儒雅青年何志平朝带秦怀安他们过来的筑基修士陆勋抱拳说道。
“好，何师兄。诸位师兄，如果没有其他事，在下就先告辞了。”陆勋抱拳和东曦峰的几位修士告别。
“陆师弟一路辛苦，那我们就不多留陆师弟了，欢迎常来东曦峰做客。”何志平客气道。
陆勋抱抱拳，之后取出一把飞剑，冲天而起，很快就消失在了云间。
content_en:
After Qin Huaian and others stepped off the flying boat with the foundation-building monks, the flying boat flew away. The inner disciples they recruited did not come down with them.
It seems that the inner disciples and the places where they report to the sect are also different.
The foundation-building monk led them to the door of a building on the edge of the square, clasped his fists and said to the monks at the door: "Hello, senior brothers, I am Chengfeng Lu Xun. These disciples are the outer disciples recruited by Yuntianfang City."
Several monks at the door also stood up, and the leader, an elegant young man, said with a smile: "It turns out to be Junior Brother Lu, whom I have admired for a long time! Thank you for your hard work, Junior Brother Lu, let's take over the handover."
Afterwards, the foundation-building monk who brought Qin Huaian and the others over handed the roster containing the information of these outer disciples to the elegant young man, "Senior Brother, please check."
"Okay, please wait."
After that, the elegant young man said to Qin Huaian and others: "Hello, fellow juniors and juniors, I am He Zhiping from Dongxifeng. I am responsible for handling your admission to the sect. You can call me Senior Brother He."
"All newly recruited outer disciples will be under the management of Dongxifeng for the first ten years. Within these ten years, you will all belong to Dongxifeng's disciples."
"Everyone, please take out the tokens issued to you when you were recruited. After hearing your name, you will receive the official disciple identity badge."
"Junior Brother Zhang, please come to roll call; Junior Brother Chen and Junior Brother Wang, you are responsible for changing the tokens." He Zhiping ordered the two monks next to him.
"Yes, Senior Brother He!" the three of them responded.
"Zhang Chuanwang!"
"Here we come!" A honest young man responded and walked out of the crowd, hurriedly ran forward and took out his token, "Brothers, this is my little brother's token."
After taking the honest young man's token and checking it, the monk surnamed Chen took out a copper-colored token, used a pointing pen to mark the empty spots on the token, and then said to the honest young man: "Input your spiritual power into the identity token."
"Yes." The honest young man pointed at the token and input a burst of spiritual power.
"Okay, Junior Brother Zhang, take your identity badge and wait aside."
"Liu Shuwen!"
"Here!" A pretty female nun aged seventeen or eighteen ran forward.
...
"Qin Huaian!" Hearing his name, Qin Huaian ran forward. After changing his identity badge, he also stood aside. He can be regarded as officially becoming a disciple of Huangshan Sword Sect, although he is an outer sect.
The identity card is red copper, and the main material should be red copper essence. It is a brand that is as big as the palm of your hand. It is very heavy to buy, weighing more than ten kilograms.
It says 'Dongxifeng
Qin Huaian
Two three three three’.
Dongxi Peak should be the mountain peak they belong to, and 2333 should be a number. I don’t know what it means.
About an hour and a half later, all the outer disciples in Yuntianfang City got their own identity cards.
"Junior Brother Lu, the inspection has been completed. There is no problem. Thank you very much, Junior Brother Lu." The elegant young man He Zhiping said to Lu Xun, the foundation-building monk who brought Qin Huaian and the others over, cupping his fists.
"Okay, Senior Brother He. Senior brothers, if you have nothing else to do, I'll take my leave now." Lu Xun clasped his fists and bid farewell to several monks from Dongxifeng.
"Junior Brother Lu has worked hard all the way, so we won't keep Junior Brother Lu around anymore. You are welcome to visit Dongxifeng often." He Zhiping said politely.
Lu Xun clasped his fists, then took out a flying sword, soared into the sky, and quickly disappeared into the clouds.
